summary: Iter 54 — Team Hub multi-team Roster + Payment Tracking. Backend: 7/7 pytest tests pass (roster team_ids list persistence, team_id filter incl. 'none', last_name then first_name sort, roster import carries team_ids, tracker CRUD, per-member variable amount_paid+method+paid_at, summary.collected sums per-person amounts falling back to tracker.amount, member_total excludes role='parent'). Frontend UI verified via Playwright at mobile 390x844: role picker excludes Parent; multi-team select via checkmarks; athlete form shows Parent/guardian fields; coach form shows own Contact; roster list shows section headers in order Coaches → (Staff & Reps) → Athletes; a multi-team coach appears once per team under 'All teams'; payment sheet has all 8 method chips (Cash, Check, Venmo, Zelle, CashApp, PayPal, Card, Other) + Other free-text field, DateField, note; save marks paid and row shows 'amount · method · date' (e.g. '$60.00 · Venmo · 07-18-2026'); summary updates correctly to variable per-person amount ($60 collected on tracker with expected $50); Mark unpaid clears entry and drops summary. Design issue: on /team/roster the horizontal team-filter ScrollView renders chips as extremely tall vertical bars (~180-250px) on react-native-web because it has no maxHeight — chips should be ~36px pill-shaped.

ui_bugs.issue: Horizontal ScrollView for team-filter chips has no maxHeight; on react-native-web the chips stretch vertically to fill available space, rendering as 180–250px tall oval columns (esp. when roster is empty). Should add style={{ flexGrow: 0, maxHeight: 44 }} (or similar height cap) to the horizontal ScrollView so chips stay pill-shaped. Reference: /app/frontend/app/team/roster.tsx:143 (ScrollView with contentContainerStyle={styles.teamChips}).

issues: Date on paid rows shows as '07-18-2026' (MM-DD-YYYY). Consider a friendlier localized format (e.g. 'Jul 18, 2026') via formatDate util to match rest of app.

action_items: Cap the height of the horizontal team-filter ScrollView on /team/roster so chips render as short pills (e.g. add style={{ flexGrow: 0 }} or a fixed height to the ScrollView, or wrap it in a View with height ~44).
critical_code_review_comments: roster.py L34-35: legacy migration reads d['team_id'] only when d['team_ids'] is falsy — good; consider also unsetting team_id in DB on next write to fully migrate.
team_payments.py L108: default new entry structure includes 'paid_at': None and method None — consistent with model. Good.
team_payments.py L118-119: 'paid_at' override only applied when non-None; matches expected UI behavior (auto-now on mark-paid, explicit date on subsequent update).
roster.tsx L143: horizontal ScrollView needs a bounded height for react-native-web (see UI bug).
seed_data_creation: Test-created rows (TEST_ prefixed roster members, teams, and one TEST_UI_Dues tracker + household roster additions Cathy TESTCoach / Alice TESTAthlete) were all cleaned up at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_iter54_multi_team_and_payments.py (7 tests, all pass). Playwright covered: role picker without Parent, multi-team select, athlete parent contact fields, coach own contact, section-header ordering Coaches → Staff & Reps → Athletes, one-row-per-team-under-All-teams, payment method chips (all 8) + Other free-text + DateField, mark paid → row shows 'amount · method · date', Mark unpaid → clears entry & summary. Only frontend polish item: team filter chip strip stretches vertically on web.
rca_of_issue: Team-filter chip stretch: react-native-web renders a horizontal ScrollView without an explicit height as a flex child that fills remaining vertical space; because the roster.tsx layout does not cap its height and chips have paddingVertical:8 with no min/max height on the container, the child chips inherit the stretched height, producing tall ovals. Fix: constrain the ScrollView with style={{ flexGrow: 0 }} (or wrap in <View style={{ height: 44 }}>).
